outcome: Standing recommended as practical first opt-in Mac review intake. Walk and drink are useful existing-drawing action review candidates, with stepped motion disclosed and runtime travel/water-contact work still pending.

criteriaAudit.interpretation: Natural hand-drawn stepping and bending may change torso, feathers and feet. Exact byte identity is required for claimed reproducible source/export lineage, or for an expressly fixed-body rig promise; it is not a general animation-quality gate.
visualCriteria: Readable species/individual identity and plumage/proportions at intended size
Stable relative presentation scale without gross whole-body jumps
Meaningful leg or head/neck drawings rather than translation masquerading as new source animation
Visible flicker/anatomy/foot movement assessed at normal output
Honest separation of standalone playback, contact annotations, runtime behavior and final approval
criteriaAudit.minorZoomOnlyIssues: Small feather, edge or toe redraw differences do not automatically block owner-provisional intake when they are unobtrusive at intended size.

identityAndAppearance.assessment: Recognizable and reasonably coherent Mourning Dove family across the presented standing, walk and drink poses.
identityAndAppearance.evidence: Warm gray/tan body, small rounded head, slim dark bill, black folded-wing spots, long tapered tail and pink feet remain readable at visible~118px. Body/head proportions and palette remain broadly consistent between the two original source batches.
identityAndAppearance.limits: Compared with locally available walk/drink source family, not the unavailable earlier Library canonical standing pack. This is visual consistency review, not expert species/anatomy certification or physical-size approval.
identityAndAppearance.anatomy: No conspicuous extra wing/leg, detached body part, extreme leg reach or collapsed head is apparent in actual-size samples. Fine toe geometry, anatomical left/right leg labels and detailed joint motion remain unverified.

standing.recommendation: First practical opt-in review intake candidate, owner approval pending.
standing.visibleResult: Clear calm right-facing neutral with coherent silhouette and grounded-looking feet. Useful as a still resident review painting.
standing.importantLimit: One actual frame: it is static standing reuse, not an animated idle, blink, head-look or new drawing. It is byte-identical to drink neutral0.
standing.intakeWork: Mac must validate/build the canonical decoder receipt, upload through the intended review route and observe yard placement/background/relative size. No actual intake or yard placement was performed here.

walk.recommendation: Retain as moving-action review candidate; inspect in the existing isolated action selector and then bind only after stance/travel review.
walk.visibleResult: Six genuine leg/foot configurations and modest head/body changes read as stepping in place. Overall right-facing identity, body level and approximate scale remain coherent; no extreme forward leg thrust or deep crouch is visible.
walk.visibleIssues: The six-drawing gait is visibly stepped at this733ms cycle, with small head/tail silhouette and foot-shape changes. A few successive leg poses are similar, so motion is less flowing than a polished continuous walk. These are normal-size stylistic/quality limits, not a demand for body-byte equality.
walk.loop: Sampled frame5→0 return remains in the same broad stance/scale without a gross reset jump. Endpoints differ as expected for a gait cycle; equality is not required for locomotion.
walk.runtimeLimit: Standalone APNG has no translation/root motion. It proves an in-place pose sequence, not world travel, gait speed, planted-foot motion, ground adhesion or correct alternating anatomical leg roles.
walk.nextConcreteGate: Bind a short ground trajectory and identify stance/swing intervals. Review feet against stationary yard ground at the chosen speed, including start/stop and loop. If noticeable skating persists, fix timing/trajectory or specific pose contacts; do not blindly regenerate the whole pack.

drink.recommendation: Retain as drinking-like bow/recovery review candidate; actual water interaction requires a separate contact/binding gate.
drink.visibleResult: Readable head/neck lowering from standing through a forward bend into low beak poses, followed by a legible return. Same body family and approximate size are retained.
drink.visibleIssues: Lowering and recovery are visibly pose-stepped; the neck/head moves a substantial distance between the bend and low entry. Small foot redraw/lateral shifts remain at actual size. No large identity flash or gross body zoom appears in the samples, but owner should decide whether the stepped bend is acceptable on the yard background.
drink.recoveryProvenance: The delivered sequence reverses existing bend/contact frames to return to the same neutral, avoiding the old separate recovery-frame jump. Reversal adds zero drawings and does not prove a newly drawn recovery action.
drink.contactLimit: No water is rendered in the standalone preview. A low beak pose touching the image floor does not prove immersion/contact with a real object. Source feet remain annotated proxies with unknown anatomical error.
drink.nextConcreteGate: Match the low-beak envelope to the intended water surface/depth and verify both planted-looking feet and beak alignment on the real yard prop. Bind events explicitly and verify them; the preview establishes no consumed water volume.

drinkContactInterpretation.rasterContactCaveat: Exported contacts are nearest alpha-positive pixels chosen near prior foot annotations in a foot window. They are registration proxies, not certified toe-center or physical-contact measurements.
drinkContactInterpretation.sourceFootDrift: Independent recomputation confirms3.25px maximum lateral from-neutral and pairwise source-annotation drift after0.25 export, and0px annotated vertical range. This does not by itself establish rigid3.25px foot translation or quantify all raster-foot motion.
drinkContactInterpretation.handoffCorrection: The initially inspected issue omitted frame4 low-sip-blink from the x envelope. Parent corrected current handoff/build tox147.5–149.25; current hashes are recorded at review close, and image bytes remain unchanged.

presentationScaleAndEdges.uniformExportVerified: All twelve output entries independently match exact whole-canvas768→192 nearest export of their retained registered RGBA sources. There are eleven unique source frames because standing and drink0 reuse the same neutral.
presentationScaleAndEdges.visualScale: Standing and walking widths remain close. Drinking height decreases with the bow, which is a pose change rather than evidence of export zoom. Relative biological scale among yard species is still a presentation proposal.
presentationScaleAndEdges.edges: No conspicuous opaque matte or distracting halo field appears on the light browser composite at192px. Fractional alpha is retained; target-yard background/renderer review remains pending.

normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.renderMethod: page.set_content of exact retained self-contained HTML; no local-file navigation attempted
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.method: Exact self-contained retained review.html rendered with page.set_content. Walk and drink were each restarted through unique Blob URLs carrying the identical embedded APNG bytes. No phase stepping or animation-rate modification was used.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.samplePurpose: Actual192px browser screenshot samples cover walk0,1,2,3,4,5,0 and drink0,1,2,3,4,3,2,1,0 in chronological normal-speed playback.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.limits: This is sampled browser playback, not a human continuously watching the loop or real Mac yard validation. Screenshot capture spans and image-load origins do not independently certify precise wall-clock frame boundaries. Exact rational media delay chunks were parsed separately.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.noBrowserFilePolicyBypass: No file:// navigation was attempted in this task; supported set_content used readable self-contained local HTML, with no network/proxy/policy changes.
normalSpeedBrowserEvidence.standingEvidence: The single-frame standing APNG is static, so no invented temporal standing behavior is claimed.

contractScopeAudit.idleRegistrationRule: The code derives frameIds only from the idle clip, then enforces same registration across those idle frame IDs. Each dove manifest idle references only one neutral frame.
contractScopeAudit.actionContactVariance: The extra moving/feeding action frames have different contact positions, and walk changes contact count. This variance alone does NOT establish that the whole upload is invalid under the inspected idle-only registration loop. My preliminary concern was corrected after actual code inspection.
contractScopeAudit.technicalVersusSemantic: Every declared export contact is alpha-positive, and local atlas hashes/dimensions match. These checks do not certify anatomical contacts, full Sharp/Zod validation, receipt authenticity, action binding or normal-yard playback.
contractScopeAudit.yardBehaviorLimit: Current normal-yard review paint uses idle. Presence of moving/feeding clips in an intake manifest does not bind travel/drink behavior. Isolated action selection remains separate from runtime implementation.

practicalOrder: Intake standing neutral through the canonical Mac review path and obtain owner visual approval at the intended size/background.
Review the existing walk action in isolation, then test a short actual ground trajectory with stance/root timing before claiming walking works in the yard.
Fit the existing low-beak envelope to a real water surface and review the drink sequence/contact/events in the yard before claiming a drinking interaction.

Use targeted timing/pose/contact revisions only if actual-size owner review or bound behavior exposes a distracting problem; do not demand identical body RGBA or generate replacements merely to hide harmless redraw differences.
remainingBlockers: Mac canonical upload/decoder/receipt and normal-yard placement/playback evidence remain pending.
Walking travel/stance/root binding and drinking object/contact/event binding remain unperformed.
Owner final art judgment, biological/world scale and detailed anatomical contact approval remain pending.
finalAcceptance: No production art or actual runtime behavior accepted by this independent review; practical provisional reuse/intake recommendations are positive within the stated scope.
